experiences.config:
env:
  seed: 43
  device: cuda
  gpu_id: '7'
  gpu_memory_limit_mib: 40000
  gpu_reserve_cache: true
  preload_gpu: true
data:
  data_dir: <DATA_DIR>
  val_split: 0.15
  batch_size: 65536
  num_workers: 4
  pin_memory: true
  drop_last: false
  dataset: voxelwise
  preprocess: normalize_b0_mean
model:
  name: voxelwise
  voxelwise:
    hidden: 768
    num_layers: 6
    mlp_neck: 256
    mlp_dropout: 0.01
    use_KAN: false
training:
  epochs: 800
  lr: 0.0003
  log_every: 1
  ckpt_every: 5
  grad_clip: 0.5
  optimizer:
    name: adamw
    adam:
      weight_decay: 0.0
    adamw:
      weight_decay: 1.0e-05
    sgd:
      momentum: 0.9
      weight_decay: 0.0
  scheduler:
    name: warmup_plateau
    warmup_plateau:
      warmup_epochs: 20
      mode: min
      factor: 0.5
      patience: 25
      min_lr: 5.0e-07
      eta_min: 0.0
  early_stopping:
    enabled: true
    patience: 160
    min_delta: 5.0e-07
loss:
  data_consistency:
    shell_weighting: manual
    shell_weights:
    - 0.6
    - 1.4
    MSE:
      weight: 1.0
    MAE:
      weight: 0.05
    Huber:
      weight: 0.1
      beta: 0.02
    SSIM:
      weight: 0.0
    Rician:
      weight: 0.02
      s_noise: auto
  KL:
    weight: 0.0
    beta: 1.0
  parameter_map:
    TV:
      weight: 0.0
    CoordGradL2:
      weight: 0.0
      normalize: true
      weights: []
    CoordFiniteDiffL2:
      weight: 0.0
      eps: 0.005
      normalize: true
      weights: []
    CoordBending:
      weight: 0.0
      normalize: true
      weights: []
physics:
  name: DTI
  constrain_weight: 1000
